title: Mean of the multiplicative derivative
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $F:(\mathbb F_2)^n\to\mathbb R$. The uniform expectation over $y$ and then $x$ of $F(x+y)F(x)$ equals the square of the uniform expectation of $F$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is any real-valued function on $(\mathbb F_2)^n$
